Summer has fully settled in, bringing with it increased traffic at the borders of Acaristan. To help you meet this challenge, the Party has prepared a solid package of improvements to make your duty more efficient and enjoyable!
All border guards are now equipped with backpacks that allow them to carry even more contraband and personal gear. To expand your inventory, upgrade your quarters via the office computer.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/6c790688bb80cd4237fd841bbfe54e08bd4d88a2.png"]

A new trend has taken Acaristan by storm! Handy carry bags for belongings have flooded the market. After some improvements by the manufacturer, they’re now seen not only with civilians and police officers but also among members of criminal organizations.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/11c8cc870aa3ff51e43f896435c9fa55b4bfdf1a.png"]

Thanks to the cooperation between the Minister of Defense and active Border Guard members, a number of quality-of-life improvements have been implemented. Key updates include the ability to adjust police siren volume, adjust UV flashlight color, modify the frequency of road ambushes and easier interaction for many objects.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/b6608e3c93f3deb08ca25b4997ea20e40d41a45e.png"]

To ensure the best possible Contraband Police experience on Steam Deck, we've prepared numerous improvements to font readability, optimization, and game stability. The game is currently undergoing Steam certification – as soon as we receive a response, we’ll inform you in a separate announcement. All future updates will also be fully compatible with Steam Deck.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/befa70b33aacee45a25beab15d2e9fa33653407a.png"]

The most important changes in this version include improvements to the body-looting system, better visibility of office computer panels, and the introduction of scalable inventory. We’ve also added many of your requested enhancements and fixed bugs from version 10.6.4.
Wishing you a peaceful duty and a relaxing holiday!
Crazy Rocks Team

notes.title: By order of the Party, the following is hereby announced

items.text: As of today, Spring Update goes live, introducing most of the improvements developed during the console porting process. Additionally, this update addresses the most frustrating gameplay issues and community-reported bugs from recent months.
In the near future, you can expect further updates focused on optimization (especially the animation system) and additional gameplay fixes.

At this stage, our work is fully focused on implementing the new animation system. Due to significant game load during any gameplay restart, we were forced to replace the existing system with our proprietary solution, designed to ensure full stability across all platforms.
Full testing of the finished system will begin later this month.

This version brings significant improvements to game stability and location loading times. In addition, we’ve implemented over 100 fixes addressing the most common bugs and incorporating your feedback and suggestions.

Thank you for the overwhelmingly positive reception of our trailer! Your support gives us great motivation to continue working on Contraband Police. Alongside the console porting efforts, our art team is busy creating new terrain and locations.

As a teaser, we present the entrance to the new police station, serving as the Police Base from the basic version of the game. More information about the upcoming DLC will be shared in a separate announcement.
Glory to Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team

Our socialist youth joyfully welcomes the long-awaited holidays, which are a reward for their hard work and dedication in both studies and labor!
However, the Party does not forget its dedicated guardians who tirelessly defend our homeland's borders.
A brand new weapon is being introduced to the police arsenal, perfect for close-quarters combat.
Drivers arrive in Acaristan with new species of well-known animals. These species have a more natural appearance and behavior.
Rumor has it that members of the Oberankov gang have refined their tactics, making them an even greater threat to our borders. Additionally, they will react more realistically to critical hits.
This is the largest patch to date, introducing over 90 fixes and improvements. We are also working on an important optimization package that will be released shortly.
We wish everyone a great holiday in Acaristan and beyond!
Glory to Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team

We are thrilled to announce that the long-awaited Anniversary Update is now available!

This is a special moment for us, and we want to celebrate it with you all. We would like to sincerely thank you for the time we've spent together and for your support, which has motivated us every day.

The game premiered a year ago, and since then, a lot has happened. We have worked very hard to introduce two new game modes and to address your suggestions and feedback. Thanks to you, Contraband Police is evolving and getting better every day.
Companion System
New vehicle "Sina"
New weapon "Sniper Rifle" with Kill-Cam effect
Foot chases
Citizen reactions to player behavior
Additionally, we would like to cordially invite you to a live stream, which is happening right now!
It's a great opportunity to share your thoughts with us about the new update.
Once again, we thank you for your commitment and support. We hope that the new update will bring you a lot of joy and enjoyable moments in the world of Acaristan.
Best,
Crazy Rocks Team

items.text: The Annversary Update Playtest has just started!
To participate, simply click the "Request Access" icon on the game page on the Steam store. Officers who participated in previous tests will receive access automatically.
In case of any errors during the game, please contact us by email at: crazyrocksbugreport@gmail.com
We are particularly interested in testing the new "Sina" vehicle, sniper rifle, and companion system.
Please attach your game saves, you will find them in C:/Users//AppData/LocalLow/CrazyRocks/ContrabandPolice

In case of crashes, please send your log files (".dmp" files from AppData/Local/Temp/CrazyRocks/ContrabandPolice/Crashes and files "Player.Log" and "Player-prev.log" from AppData/LocalLow/CrazyRocks/ContrabandPolice)

The greatest help for our team is to provide a short gameplay video (e.g. using obs, fraps) that shows the problem. It is good that such a recording starts some time before the error occurs. However, if you decide not to record - please send screenshots.
Your help and suggestions have always been very important to us. The current quality of the game is largely due to your merit! We are waiting for your valuable comments and any bugs you find.
Best,
Crazy Rocks Team

This is the last update in the series of the post-launch fixes. From now on, we are completely focused on the Endless Mode work. Of course, we'll still read your suggestions and support you whenever you encounter any problem.

notes.title: This week we've fixed the following issues

items.text: Loading the last checkpoint sometimes didn't work.
Picking up a weapon during the Convoy and Prologue no longer blocks the "Armed to the Teeth" achievement.
Fix for getting stuck in the engine or inside the escapee's car.
Teleportation over long distances after getting out of the car.
Block on blowing up the car of the arrested person.
Cars will no longer get stuck in the Inspection Zone.
Enemies in the car will no longer block Post Attack completion.
Mission description may have appeared before we got the call.
You could stop a runaway car by asking a Comrade Repnin to fix the police car.
Block after killing a prisoner sent to the quarry.
Car could have changed its position after giving the prisoners to the Labor Camp.
Going to bed close to the morning misses the day.
Block after starting the engine from a place other than the driver's seat.
Parked cars will no longer slide on the ground.
Two additional slots for your game saves!
Additional items can now be found in the bodies of killed gangsters.
On the contraband digging mission, you can now find a shovel left by gangsters.
Invert mouse setting also works on the car's TPP camera.
We are pleased with the progress on the Endless Mode so far. It is scheduled for release in May 2023. You will definitely love all it's features such as:
New outpost expansion possibilities.
More cars in one day.
Over 20 new entry regulations.
Random side missions every day (activated on request).
Ranked challenge mode (how many days can you last at the post?).
10 promotion levels.
Glory to Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team

items.text: The situation with release bugs is mostly under control. We didn't expect you to help us so much even after the premiere! In order to meet your expectations, we've prepared new settings that will help you better adjust the game to your preferences.

notes.title: From now on, in the gameplay options tab, you can

items.text: Turn on and off hints about smugglers.
Adjust the length of the day (25,35,45 minutes).
Turn off head bobbing.
Change the crouch and aim mode from hold to toggle.
Toggle camera smoothing.

notes.title: We've also fixed the following issues

items.text: Missing texts (red text in the menu and game).
Game over at the sawmill shooting on day 5.
Blocked sleeping after serving all newcomers.
Loading stopped at 95%.
Some contraband was not shown in the inspection report.
Fixed bug with killing the driver when getting in or out.
You could stuck on Varila 4x4 hood when it closes.
Fixed sniper on the post tower.
There are some new improvements too!
Pressing the G key in the driver's seat will automatically start the engine.
From now on, you can always load the last checkpoint.
You won't be forced to turn on the siren on the first chase in the prologue.
You won't be punished for killing smugglers and prisoners.
Civilians now have less HP.
Doors can no longer be closed when the driver is getting in or out.
Thank you for all the reports you've send us via email and steam discussions. Together, we make the game better every day!
Best,
Crazy Rocks Team

For all of you who didn't like the sudden attacks on the outpost and road ambushes, we've introduced special Gameplay Options with the ability to disable these features. Additionally, you can now change the difficulty of opponents and even comparing document fields!
We've also added cloud game saves! You can finally synchronize game progress with your steam account and also play the game at GeForce NOW.

notes.title: In addition, we were able to fix the following issues

items.text: Corrupted save files will no longer cause the game to freeze when loading.
You can now catch any runaway even with the default police car.
Fixed some unexpected crashes during gunfights.
Fixed misjudged inspection due to papers background and stamp mistakes.
Newcomers wont turn in a strange way when getting into their car.
Achievements: Merciful, Perfect Inspector, Unstoppable are now obtainable.
Fixed a bug with incorrect death in the Crime Scene mission (Chapter IV).
Fixed disappearing subtitles during missions.
Fixed a bug where a player was blocked while using the work phone.
When the player finds no mistake in the documents, the inspection summary will show which document it was in.
Runaway will no longer ram other newcomers in the inspection zone.
We gave more time to search the car of the captured fugitive.
Fixed a bug that prevented the last mission from launching.
Prisoners will no longer escape from the car if the player is nearby.

We apologize for those problems and thank you for your understanding. With that big production, it's hard to avoid all the mistakes. Fortunately, there are fewer and fewer of them and soon we'll be able to fully concentrate on the Free Mode.
Stay tuned for next updates!
Glory to Acaristan,
Crazy Rocks Team
As promised, we just released an update that fixes the following issues:
Acaristan was too dangerous. We have reduced the number of ambushes and police cars are now much more durable!
Accepting missions and answering the phone no longer cause an instant losing.

Sometimes our opponents were too afraid of a fight and stayed hidden for too long. We gave them some vodka for courage! ːsteamhappyː

We already have tasks gathered for the next patch, which we will release next week.
